_note: Episode 1 version 2 (the new form). Every still is one full painted picture in the Bakunawa look (pipeline/flux_hq.py style through a sequential drawer: three draws a key, the choice at 3x). 'full' holds each still's JSON prompt (subject, setting, light) and the chosen draw; old_kNN are kept stills of videos/ep01-ang-unang-talon/keys. Writing in pictures is added in code after the choice: bk_08 SANGLAAN and the three slanted strokes; bk_13 HERITAGE WALK / kasama si (the flyer over the name is plain); bk_39 the episode's question; old_k14 PUGAD LAWIN 1896 (from version 1). Shot 33 (silent) is key 90, shown inside sentence 68.
